A note you cannot find again is a note you did not take.

Atoms is the whole loop: a thought goes in, in five seconds, and comes back the moment it matters.

How it works

You only do the first step.

  1. ↳

    Catch it in five seconds

    Atoms installs a shortcut on your iPhone. Run it from your home screen, the share sheet, or Siri, and say the thought out loud instead of typing it. It lands in today's daily note before you have put your phone down.

    On a desktop, type a line. Either way, nothing new to learn and nowhere new to put it.

  2. ↳

    Come back and it is sorted

    Yesterday's captures become notes with a real title and links to what they relate to. Let it happen on its own each time you open Obsidian, or keep it to one tap.

  3. ↳

    Now you can find it

    Ask for it, or let it come back to you. Both are below.

Your daily note

sam stopped at the tulip stand again, she loves the yellow ones

Your original line is never touched, and the text is copied across word for word. The milk? It becomes nothing. Atoms is not a reminders app, so errands stay in your daily note and out of your library.

When you go looking

Ask from Claude or ChatGPT

Atoms plugs into the chat window you already have open, so your own notes become something you can question.

  • It reads the library, not the pile. Every note it looks at already has a real title, tags, and links. That is why the answers are any good. Pointing a chatbot at raw daily pages does not work.
  • Ask for it. It finds your notes by title, tags, and text, then quotes them back with a link to the original.
  • Follow the thread. Your notes form a graph, and it walks the links. The gift question finds the tulip note because both point at Sam.
  • Follow the thread. Your notes form a graph, and it walks the links. The pitch question finds the budget note because both point at Priya.
  • Follow the thread. Your notes form a graph, and it walks the links. The afternoon question finds the lunch note because both point at Energy.
  • Add without leaving chat. Tell it to remember something and it queues a new note for your vault. It lands next time Obsidian is open.
  • Change your mind safely. A revision becomes a new note linked to the old one. It never overwrites you.

When you are not looking

Open Atoms and it may hand you one thing you had forgotten.

  • Mind change. Two notes where you came to disagree with yourself, side by side, with the dates.
  • Also about Sam. Write something new about someone and an older note about them comes back.
  • Also about Priya. Write something new about someone and an older note about them comes back.
  • Also about Energy. Write something new on a theme and an older note about it comes back.
  • On this day. Something you wrote on this date a year ago.
  • One card, then done. Tap to open it, or ask for another. The same memory will not return for a week.

A little web of your life

Every link above is real structure. Atoms can open your library as a graph: your notes and what they point at, not the whole vault hairball.

What stays true

  • See it before it writes. Preview shows the exact notes, links, and markers Process would create. Nothing touches your vault until you say so.
  • Your words, unchanged. Only the title, tags, and links are written for you. A half-formed hunch stays half-formed instead of becoming confident-sounding prose.
  • Links, not folders. Nothing gets filed away somewhere you have to remember.
  • Plain files you own. Uninstall tomorrow and every note is still there, still readable.
  • Not a task app. No due dates, no checklists, no backlog filling up behind you.

Your Own Key

Free forever

You pay Anthropic directly for usage.

Add your Anthropic API key in Settings and Atoms works. Asking from chat is hosted, so it is Plus, or self host it yourself.

Plus includes 150 notes filed each month. Unused ones do not roll over. Extra filings are $2 for 50, one time. 14 days free, then $6/month. Cancel anytime. Card required for trial. You cancel from Settings inside the plugin. Prices in USD.

Install

Get Atoms

Atoms is not in the plugin directory yet, so it goes through BRAT.

  1. Install BRAT from Obsidian's community plugins.
  2. Add the beta plugin taihartman/obsidian-atoms.
  3. Enable Atoms.
  4. Open Settings → Atoms and add your key, or start a trial.

Rather read the code first? It is all on GitHub.

Privacy

Where your notes go

  • Processing sends capture text to Anthropic. That is how the sorting works. On Plus it goes under our account, on your own key it goes under yours.
  • We do not train on your notes.
  • Asking from chat is opt in. Nothing leaves your vault until you turn it on, and then only your atoms folder. It goes one direction only, and never writes back over a note.

The whole story is on the Privacy page.
